statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let ram (q h : ℕ) := ∑ a ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q), E ((h : ℝ) * (a : ℝ) / q); ∀ q h : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → Nat.Coprime h q → ram q h = (ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℂ)

plain_statement.en: At every frequency h coprime to a positive modulus q, the sum of exp(2πiha/q) over reduced residues a modulo q equals μ(q).
plain_statement.zh: 若 h 与正整数 q 互素，则 exp(2πiha/q) 在模 q 的简化剩余系上的和等于 μ(q)。

brief.en: The coprime powers of a primitive q-th root run through all primitive q-th roots. Partition the full root sum by exact order and apply Möbius inversion.
brief.zh: 本原 q 次单位根的互素次幂恰遍历全部本原 q 次单位根。按阶划分所有单位根，再作莫比乌斯反演。
